Subject: Re: Hosted -> Dedicated move: traffic samples and target SLA

Tom — thanks for the sample and the clarity on the SLA targets. High-level next steps from Redwood:

1) Sizing validation: run a dedicated preflight in our staging cluster with your sample traffic (we template the traffic and run 3-day soak). Deliverables: throughput report (p50/p95), cost delta, and a KV/cache warmup profile.
2) Acceptance gates: throughput +/-10% of expected, no single-model p95 > 400ms, and error rate delta < 0.1%.
3) Cutover cadence (recommended):
   - Week 0: commit & capacity reservation (contract sign + build schedule)
   - Week 1: provisioning + staging preflight (3-day soak)
   - Week 2: canary (1% traffic) -> 5% -> 25% over 48hr windows if sane
   - Week 3: full swap; fallbacks to hosted shards for 72hr window

We can map exact dates to your Apr 9 compliance window. Karthik — can you run an initial rightsize estimate against the attached CSV and return an ETA for the staging preflight runbook? Marissa — I'll need a proposed commit tier table tied to the canary cadence so we can align billing and refunds if we miss acceptance gates.

Monica
Sr. Customer Solutions, Redwood Inference

[Attachment referenced: cutover-window-checklist.pdf (pdf)]

Quick initial sizing notes (ballpark) based on the CSV: peak sustained windows ~220 QPS with many short requests (~avg tokens 28). Mix is ~75% streaming / 25% batch. Using our standard theta model family profile and conservative warmup coefficients I get:

- Initial dedicated reservation: 8 x A100-sim-equivalent slots (we interpret slots as 8x of our baseline), which maps to roughly 3.5k concurrent tokens/sec sustained under current request distribution.
- Expected p50 latency: ~90-110ms with continuous batching and prefix caching; p95 baseline estimate: 300-380ms depending on KV cache hit rates.
- Suggested staging headroom: +25% capacity for soak so we can validate autoscale/backpressure and stress fallback to hosted.

ETA: I can spin the staging soak runbook by Thu 2028-03-08 end of day if Jordan and infra give the provisioning window. I'll attach a short runbook and the preliminary commit-to-tier mapping once validated.

Karthik
Principal Infrastructure Engineer
Redwood Inference
